I worked through all 80 rules in the generated checklist against `git diff 7399f2d95...HEAD` (9 files). Nothing was modified, installed or posted. The one exception is the temporary checklist file `docs/engineering/pr-self-review-checklist.generated.md`, which the skill regenerates on every run. It is untracked and should not be committed, and I didn't tick its boxes. I didn't need to look up the review history behind any rule.

## Rules that applied

| Rule | Result |
|---|---|
| API-01 Search consumers when removing an export | ✅ Pass. `ContractErrorCodes` had one consumer, `useIsValidExecution.ts`, and it was migrated. No other imports remain. |
| PKG-01 No app-local copy of shared package files | ✅ Pass. The mapping moved out of `apps/web` into `packages/utils`, and no copy is left behind. |
| SEC-01 Own-property checks on external map keys | ✅ Pass. `isGsCode` uses `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call`, so a value like `"toString"` can't match. |
| TEST-01 Tests must fail on the regression they claim to cover | ❌ Fails, finding 1 |
| TEST-02 New branches need their own tests | ❌ Fails, finding 2 |
| PROD-01 Visible behaviour changes need explicit product intent | ⚠️ Linked to finding 1 |
| CODE-04 Work things out once before the JSX | ⚠️ Nit, finding 6 |
| Root `AGENTS.md`: comments are tech debt; tests sit next to their source | ⚠️ Findings 3 and 4 |

All other rules (auth, RTK, CI, mobile, e2e, transactions, numerics and so on) don't touch this diff.

## Findings

**1. The new user-facing message is never shown to anyone: medium (TEST-01, PROD-01)**
- `apps/web/src/hooks/useIsValidExecution.ts:84` writes the mapped message into `err.reason`, but no consumer reads `reason`:
  - `ExecuteForm.tsx:295` and `RecoverAccountReview/index.tsx:163` show fixed text ("This transaction will most likely fail…").
  - The Details panel in `ErrorMessage/index.tsx` shows `error.message`, and ethers builds that when the error is created, so it doesn't change.
- The test `apps/web/src/features/recovery/hooks/__tests__/useIsValidExecution.test.ts:60` is titled "should map a known GS revert reason to its user-facing message", but it only checks `.reason`. It would still pass if no UI ever showed the message.
- The story `ContractErrorMessages.stories.tsx:99` says "The message you see is the new copy", but the story passes the message in as `children`, which production never does.
- Either wire the message into the rendered text, or say plainly in the PR that rendering comes later.

**2. `{token}` and `{nativeAsset}` placeholders can come through unfilled, with no test covering it: medium (TEST-02)**
- `apps/web/src/hooks/useIsValidExecution.ts:84-86` only passes `nativeAsset`. GS012 therefore always comes out as "Not enough {token} to cover the network fee…".
- GS011 comes out as "Not enough {nativeAsset}…" whenever `chain` is undefined.
- `packages/utils/src/services/exceptions/__tests__/contractErrors.test.ts:67` treats the leftover placeholder as intended behaviour.
- No hook test covers the chain-symbol interpolation branch.
- A test for each branch is needed, plus either a fallback word for missing parameters or passing `token` through.

**3. Comments refer to ticket numbers and internal planning labels: low (root `AGENTS.md`, "Treat code comments as tech debt")**
- The code refers to "Topic 2/4/6", "Bucket A/B/C", "AC #2" and "WA-3005". Those labels mean nothing outside the ticket and will go stale. Places:
  - `packages/utils/src/services/exceptions/contractErrors.ts:48-52, 118-122`
  - `apps/web/src/components/tx/ErrorMessage/ContractErrorMessages.stories.tsx:13-19, 57, 73-78, 99`
  - both parity test headers (`apps/web/src/services/contracts/__tests__/contractErrorsParity.test.ts:7-13`, `apps/mobile/src/services/__tests__/contractErrorsParity.test.ts:7-13`)
- The Topic label also shows up on screen in the story's headings and alert text.

**4. The two parity tests repeat the package test and aren't next to any source file: low (root `AGENTS.md`, tests next to their source; TEST-01)**
- `apps/web/src/services/contracts/__tests__/contractErrorsParity.test.ts:1` now sits in a folder whose source file (`ContractErrorCodes.ts`) was deleted.
- It and `apps/mobile/src/services/__tests__/contractErrorsParity.test.ts:1` check the same strings as `packages/utils/.../contractErrors.test.ts`. Both apps read one shared module, so these tests can't catch a difference between web and mobile that the package test would miss.

**5. Count hardcoded in the story heading: low (DRY)**
- `ContractErrorMessages.stories.tsx:29` says "All 32 GS codes". Use `CODES.length` so the heading stays right when codes are added. The test at `contractErrors.test.ts:21-22` locks the count on purpose, which is fine.

**6. The same lookup is repeated inside the JSX: nit (CODE-04)**
- `ContractErrorMessages.stories.tsx:47-48` reads `CONTRACT_ERRORS[code].handling` twice. Store it in a local variable once.
- `handlingColor` (`:24`) could also take `ContractErrorHandling` instead of `string`.

**7. Inconsistent punctuation in the new copy: nit (UI copy consistency)**
- `packages/utils/src/services/exceptions/contractErrors.ts:92` (GS400) is two sentences but has no final period.
- The other two-sentence messages end with one, and the one-line field-validation messages (Bucket A, `:84-90`) don't. Pick one convention.

## Unresolved

Findings 1 and 2 are still open. The PR shouldn't claim the new copy is live until it actually renders in the UI.
